ctx.x: Whether it was Red Nichols or even Fletcher Henderson started at the time.
I got a picture of Fletcher Fletcher Henderson, and Duke Ellington was just starting. But Red Nichols and the Wolverines were top bands, then came Frankie Trumbauer.
And I'd get all the recordings, in this music store, and they'd hold it all for me, wouldn't sell one of the recordings until I came and heard it.
